## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem. E.g. "I always have to manually check for X when reviewing AI PRs."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear description of what you want to happen. Include example CLI invocations or Action config if relevant.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, links to related issues, or screenshots here.
